command:
set -euo pipefail
REL='anime_90s/anime_fassungslos/frontal/stufe_00.png'
echo '===SUBJECT==='
sha256sum buehne.html buehne_daemon.py
echo '===EXPRESSION_VARIANTS==='
for d in ausdruck_erweitert ausdruck_erweitert_ai ausdruck_erweitert_relief2; do
  if test -d "$d"; then
    n=$(find "$d" -type f -path '*/frontal/stufe_*.png' | wc -l)
    printf '%s FRONTAL_COUNT=%s ' "$d" "$n"
    if test -f "$d/$REL"; then sha256sum "$d/$REL"; else echo REPRESENTATIVE_MISSING; fi
  else
    echo "$d DIR_MISSING"
  fi
done
echo '===HTTP_AUTHORITY==='
printf 'HTTP '; curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:8788/ausdruck_erweitert/$REL?authority=3" | sha256sum
echo '===SERVICE==='
systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service
echo SCOPE=READ_ONLY_PRODUCTIVE_SPECIAL_EXPRESSION_AUTHORITY_BINDING
